reason: Measured branch data showed that several db.js defense-in-depth branches are dominated by earlier exact-SQL fail-closed checks. Requiring 90 percent in every security file would force implementation-detail mocks or weaker validation and exceeds the canonical GOV-03 aggregate requirement.
decision: Enforce the canonical 90 percent threshold over the frozen aggregate of all security-critical files using integer counters
Require every security-critical file to have a non-zero denominator and disclose exact per-file counters
Keep dominated branches in the aggregate denominator; no ignore annotations or denominator trimming
Keep non-decreasing per-file line floors after the final measured run
Raise aggregate coverage through real invalid metadata, database, Session and Link behaviors rather than internal mocks
